versions.content: The part <NAME> from [SWS_MemMap_00022] may con- tain the following ASIL keywords to indicate the restriction/qualifications: {safety} = QM , ASIL_A , ASIL_B , ASIL_C , ASIL_D The {safety} tag is optional and indicates the maximum possible safety level. Down- scaling in the project is possible inside memory mapping header files. If no {safety} keyword is added the default shall be treated as QM (without any ASIL qualification).
